rules: Use a fresh isolated database for each callback and exact existing validators; invalid initialAuthorizationView or authorizationPolicy is not the legitimate generation1 empty state.
RU authpolicy and credentials are current capture, not stored installation equality. A later current policy may differ without installation replacement.
A valid TX generation1 empty policy remains accepted; its actual effective metadata differs and must be retained internally for D3d binding.
Keep exact supported TX legacy configuration comparison/migration; malformed unsupported rows refuse without inventing a new format.
Resource/retained-runtime failure may occur after lawful claim recovery or expiry. Record actual selected rows and effects; no blanket byte-unchanged or rollback claim.
A failed opener can internally acquire and close SQLite before throwing; caller owner-acquisition remains zero.
